title: New study estimates 75 percent of former NFL players who died from 2008 to 2023 had CTE

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: New study estimates 75 percent of former NFL players who died from 2008 to 2023 had CTE
sources.description: A new study from JAMA Network Open by researchers at Boston University, Mass General Brigham, and the Concussion & CTE Foundation has found that an estimated 75 percent of former NFL players who died between 2008 and 2023 had CTE.
